# FG-REVIEW-0020

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_annotation_over_the_limit_is_check_payload_invalid` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: チェックの報告の内容が正しくありません。名前・状態・結論・注釈を確かめて、もう一度送ってください。
- en: The check report is not valid. Check its name, status, conclusion and annotations, then send it again.
- id: Laporan pemeriksaan tidak valid. Periksa nama, status, kesimpulan, dan anotasinya, lalu kirim lagi.

## 原因 (cause)

`POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/commits/{sha}/checks` (or `gstn checks report`) sent a report that breaks the Checks API's rules (ADR-0024 §10, docs/api/checks.md): `reason=name_invalid` (not `<namespace>/<name>` under CheckName::parse, or an unknown namespace), `status_invalid`, `conclusion_invalid`, `conclusion_without_completed` / `completed_without_conclusion` (a conclusion exists exactly when the status is `completed`), `summary_too_long` (over 64 KiB), `summary_invalid` (a NUL character), `details_url_invalid` (not an http or https URL with a host, over 2 KiB, or with credentials; the server never fetches it), `too_many_annotations` (over 50), `annotation_path_invalid` (empty, absolute, a drive letter such as `C:`, a `..` segment, a backslash or a control character, over 4096 bytes), `annotation_lines_invalid` (a line below 1, or the end before the start), `annotation_level_invalid`, `annotation_message_invalid` (empty or over 4 KiB), `annotation_title_invalid` (over 255 bytes). Decided after the authorization (a caller who may not report gets the denial, never a hint about the body) — except `name_invalid`, decided first because the name's namespace is an input of the decision (it depends on the body alone, so it reveals nothing about the project). Also `reason=namespace_not_grantable` from the grant administration (`PUT|DELETE /api/v1/admin/service-accounts/{id}/check-grants/{project_id}/{namespace}`): only `ci` and `kanflow` are granted. Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason`, `project_id`, `name` (only when it parsed) and for annotations `index` (its position in the list) and `limit` / `len` where a size broke the rule — never the summary, URL or message text.

## 対処 (fix)

Fix the report and send it again; the rules are in docs/api/checks.md (`gstn checks report --help` shows the options).
